# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P22](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0022), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016)</sub>

## Appearance

She has red hair. She wears fashionable dresses featuring flounces.

## Personality

Flossie is marked by a caustic, vindictive, and difficult temperament. She is bold and has no hesitation about asking direct questions. Superstitious in nature, she believes the number thirteen brings bad luck.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001)_

## Traits

- caustic-tongued
- bold and direct  <sub>[v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031)</sub>
- lacks imagination and creative mind
- superstitious  <sub>[v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007)</sub>
- patronizing  <sub>[v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 c2 P2](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0002)</sub>

## Abilities

- knitting lace

## Goals

- gaining an education without needing to earn a living  <sub>[v1 c30 P22](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0022)</sub>

## History

Flossie attended Brierley School under Miss Thorne, participating in school recitations despite her open disdain for them. Along with Nell Harcourt, Odette Pullen, and Opal Pettigrew, she took the entrance exams for Regent's Academy in town. She passed the examinations by a thin margin. While attending college, she noted that she pursued higher education solely for learning's sake since she would not need to earn a livelihood. Later, Flossie and her family hosted a send-off celebration for Nell and Hugh Carrow organized by the B.V.I.S., where she acted patronizingly toward Nell.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P22](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0022), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 c2 P2](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Her father is wealthy enough to pay her tuition so she does not need to work  <sub>[v1 c30 P22](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0022)</sub>
- Won top prize for knitted lace at an exhibition
- Lost her top class rank after misspelling 'ebullition'
- Challenged Nell Harcourt to walk a roof ridgepole, causing a severe injury
